note.fr: Vérifiez si votre diplôme marocain est reconnu comme qualification d'entrée à l'université allemande. Vous pourriez avoir besoin de 1 à 2 années d'études universitaires au Maroc.
note.en: Check if your Moroccan diploma is recognised as a German university entrance qualification. You may need 1-2 years of prior university study in Morocco.

evidence.quote: Applicants must provide a university entrance qualification that is recognised in Germany.
applicants from many countries must complete one or two years of attendance at their home country's universities before they fulfill the German university entry requirements
